description: The Machine Commerce Observatory: independent readings of x402 and MPP endpoints — alive right now, quoting what, and how fast? Probed on a published schedule under one published rubric, every reading traceable to a retained capture. Blocked and rate-limited are told apart from unreachable at capture time, so a defended endpoint is never reported as dead. Call before paying an unfamiliar endpoint, or to check whether one you use has repriced or rotated its payTo. This tool is the FREE grade: current observation plus 7 days of counts, by endpoint_id or by url. The same record our published reports are written from.

endpoint_id.description: probe402 endpoint id (ep_ + 16 hex characters), from the free /coverage list

url.description: the address an agent is about to pay, looked up as the free /grade?url= does; a host URL lists that host's routes

name: probe402_endpoint_grade
title: Free grade: the current reading and 7 days of counts, by id or by URL
